en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view across a harbor toward a city skyline. In the foreground are piers, small boats, and waterfront warehouses; in mid‑harbor a white passenger ship is sailing. On the opposite shore stand rows of multi‑story buildings and several prominent landmarks, including a large domed cathedral on the left and another tall church building on the right. The text at the bottom left names the location in Finnish and Swedish, and a small code appears at the bottom right.
